message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"The current LUT/linear design only reaches the required 8-LSB accuracy at phase_bits=16, costing 1584.6 um^2. Increasing precision further is unavailable, and the remaining legal moves are decrease_precision, decrease_table_capacity, change_interpolation, or switch_architecture. Switching architecture is the best next high-level search because it can potentially meet the accuracy target with a different CORDIC/LUT structure and better area tradeoff, whereas decreasing precision/table capacity or changing interpolation would likely worsen the already-failing accuracy."}
